title: A ZFC counterexample to Naimark's problem

result.label: A ZFC counterexample to Naimark's problem
result.statement: Gives an alternative to [Tanaka's ZFC construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.26930v1) of a unital infinite-dimensional simple complex C ∗ -algebra with a faithful tracial state and exactly one nonzero irreducible representation up to unitary equivalence. Thus the unrestricted compact-operator characterization fails without additional set-theoretic assumptions; the counterexample is nonseparable.
